summary: A future on NFO with open interest: a Quote client, then a Depth client (ModeChange to DEPTH), whose DepthTick serves both; the Depth client leaves (ModeChange back to QUOTE) and the next QuoteTick reaches the Quote client only; the last one leaves (Unsubscribe).

notes: Broker-facing frames: every Subscribe, ModeChange and Unsubscribe the case expects is byte for byte the web adapter's (sahi_adapter.py _flush_locked, _on_open), 500 ids a frame at most.
accepted (lead 2026-11-09): inside one batch the web sorts the ids and the modes (sorted(adds.items()), sorted(ids)); the desktop keeps their arrival order, which Sahi cannot observe.

accepted (lead 2026-11-09): the web holds subscription changes for 0.5 s (BATCH_DELAY), so a subscribe undone inside that window sends nothing; the desktop sends the subscribe and the unsubscribe, extra traffic only.

The web sends one window's changes as unsubscribes, then mode changes, then subscribes (_flush_locked), which frees Sahi's 1000-instrument cap first; lane life matches that order in the shared manager.

deviations.reason: web pads each side to five rows of price 0.0 (sahi_mapping.py::_depth_side); docs: buy/sell are the broker's levels; never invent zero prices (decisions.md). The padding is the adapter's own: Sahi's DepthTick carries only the levels holding orders, as repeated best_buys (field 11) and best_sells (field 12) entries with no fixed empty slots (sahi_proto.py:228-231; sahi_mapping.py:99). The desktop keeps every level Sahi sent, up to five.
The web's server also sends this client a richer mode's publication of the instrument, beyond the modes it holds; the desktop sends one frame per held mode.
deviations.ref: websocket_proxy/server.py zmq_listener (for m in range(1, mode + 1))
